commentary: While benchmark indices push fresh territory past 23,650 backed by robust institutional inflows, market breadth remains selective at 40%, demanding classic O'Neil and Weinstein market-direction discipline. Under a WEAK deterministic gate, seasoned practitioners avoid broad-market euphoria and refrain from chasing extended names. Instead, we enforce progressive exposure, demanding strict alignment between Stage 2 structural breakouts and CANSLIM-certified earnings acceleration. Only setups demonstrating true volatility contraction, institutional volume accumulation, and triple-digit earnings torque deserve capital. Non-equity cash equivalents and fundamentally lagging turnaround candidates must be filtered out, preserving dry powder exclusively for premier leadership pivots while honoring predetermined stop-loss triggers.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Mark Minervini SEPA, William O'Neil CANSLIM, Stan Weinstein Stage Analysis, Nicolas Darvas Box Theory

21STCENMGM.technical: Price cleared a 20-session high to establish fresh 52-week highs on 2.67x volume expansion, holding above the rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. While satisfying Darvas breakout criteria, low liquidity and erratic historical swings weaken its structural quality.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Sales surged 253.5% YoY to ₹11 crore in Q2 FY27 as operations turned profitable. However, erratic trailing performance (FY26 loss of ₹240 crore and negative ROE) fails sustained CANSLIM earnings consistency tests. Zero long-term debt remains a minor positive.
21STCENMGM.risk: Failure below the breakout pivot and stop level at ₹54.81 invalidates the momentum setup; enforce an immediate, disciplined exit.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a double bottom with price above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA while RSI holds at 55. However, base structure lacks tight VCP contraction, and relative strength noticeably lags broader pharmaceutical market leaders.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severely fails CANSLIM criteria: latest quarterly sales slumped 56.3% YoY to ₹44.6 crore while net profit dropped 25.6% YoY. Weak capital efficiency (ROE 3.1%, ROCE 5.6%) and low interest coverage reflect fundamental deterioration devoid of institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A close below the secondary swing low stop at ₹103.98 breaks pattern symmetry and terminates the educational thesis entirely.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Executed a 20-day high breakout above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with RSI at 68 and bullish MACD confirmation. The base demonstrates constructive price recovery, though overhead supply requires decisive volume absorption.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 19.0% YoY to ₹703 crore, but net profit softened 6.9% YoY to ₹50.1 crore due to margin pressure, decelerating from prior quarters. Moderate ROCE (12%) and steady leverage cap fundamental conviction despite healthy sales growth.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Violation of the breakout support and stop trigger at ₹424.59 invalidates the 20-day breakout; cut losses swiftly per SEPA rules.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Carving out a double bottom above key 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and rising 200 SMA. RSI at 56 and MACD crossing above signal demonstrate constructive accumulation, setting up an actionable pivot as neckline resistance is pressured.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Textbook CANSLIM acceleration: Q2 FY27 net profit surged 156% YoY to ₹71.5 crore, following a 65.4% jump in Q1, driven by 47.8% top-line growth. Operating margins exceed 24% on CDMO scaling, backed by low debt-to-equity (0.32x) and institutional backing.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Breaching the double bottom support level and stop at ₹915.01 negates the pivot setup; execute immediate capital preservation.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: As an overnight liquid ETF, price action reflects cash management rather than market-driven equity accumulation. It completely lacks Minervini Trend Template alignment, volatility contraction, and organic volume breakouts.
ABSLLIQUID.fundamental: Cash equivalent instrument holding ultra-short sovereign and money market securities. Corporate metrics like EPS, sales growth, operating margins, ROE, ROCE, and CANSLIM institutional dynamics are fundamentally not applicable.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Thesis fails fundamentally because cash equivalents offer no equity beta or breakout potential; deploy capital elsewhere.

ACUTAAS.technical: Displays exemplary Stage 2 structure above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Forms a 22.2% rounded cup with a crisp 6.3% handle contraction in the upper half of the base, demonstrating tight VCP properties with bullish MACD.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: High-grade CANSLIM profile: Q2 FY27 revenue expanded 42.7% YoY to ₹437 crore while net profit jumped 73.3%, driven by 40%+ EBITDA margins in CDMO verticals. Return metrics are superior (ROCE 32.9%, ROE 24.6%), with zero promoter pledge and minimal debt.
ACUTAAS.risk: A daily close below the cup-and-handle pivot stop at ₹3,652.72 invalidates the pattern; execute stop loss discipline without hesitation.
